description:
Over a decade after the Decade, here it is: third generation of our greatest, competition-winning dirt jump frame.
This isn’t a revolution, as you don’t have to reimagine a frame that’s already winning competitions all around the world.
The new Decade features everything good previous generation had, some improvements, and it comes now in two sizes:
- S (short) if you like current Decade,
- and L (long) if you want more stability on the ground and while airborne!
Size L has 20mm longer reach and 10mm lower BB for added stability.
It also has 1° slacker headtube and 2° steeper seat tube angle.
MAIN FEATURES:
- 73mm threaded BSA Bottom bracket
- High-end aluminium dirt jump frame
- Unlimited barspins with gyro
- Rattle-free design with chain tensioners
- Two sizes available
IMPROVEMENTS:
- Better gyro tabs
With improved gyro tabs, mounting a gyro will be as easy as pushing a button.
Thanks to the zero-stack headset, it is compatible with most of the models available on the market.
Straight out of the box.
- External cable routing
You’ll thank us if you brake your brake hose mid-session.
- Single-mold bottom bracket + chainstay yoke
Making the frame lighter, stiffer and even stronger!
- New rear wheel dropouts with chain tensioners
Clean, simple and rattle-free!
Decade comes in three colours: Violet, Black and White!
